refnamediv.refpurpose: filter to sort Unifont HEX fonts

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: hex-sort.pl reads a font in Unifont HEX format from its standard input, sorts the glyphs into ascending codepoint order, and prints the font in the same HEX format to its standard output.
refsection.note: It is actually quite difficult to portably get sort1 to sort by variable‐length hexadecimal numeric fields.

refsection.title: Author
refsection.para: Original tool by Roman Cyzborra and Paul Hardy, with later adaptations for Unscii by Ville-Matias Heikkilä. Further adaptations and this documentation by Jonathan de Boyne Pollard.
